<b>Skarr Scouts</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are young members of the [[Skarr]] who sit along the outskirts or join in bands to fight. There is a [[Unnamed Skarr |mottled form]] of the Skarr Scout who upgrades Hornet's [[Curveclaw]], but remains unnamed.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skarr Scouts often start off resting, and do a short battle cry once Hornet approaches.<br>
Alternatively, some Skarr will be in the middle of using Sickle Throw at nearby [[Flapping Fertid]]s or [[Hardbone Elder]]s, attempting to kill them. They will, however, prioritise Hornet over the Flapping Fertids.<br>
Skarr Scouts cannot walk and can only move via their attacks. Skarr Scouts have 5 different moves to dodge and attack Hornet from any distance:
* <b>Jump:</b> Jumps in an arc and tries to land near or on Hornet.
* <b>Backdash:</b> Performs a short dash backwards to gain distance.
* <b>Burrow:</b> Dives into the ground and reappears elsewhere on the platform, as indicated by the dust being kicked up from where they're currently burrowed. If Hornet leaves their platform, they immediately Burrow and don't come back up until Hornet is on their platform again.
**  If the Skarr Scout gets pushed off their platform and onto another, they use Burrow to get back up to their original spawning platform.
* <b>Double Slash:</b> If Hornet is close enough, the Skarr Scout performs two short outwards swings that also hit slightly above themselves, moving themselves forward with each swing. This attack has remarkably short foreswing, so caution should be taken when near them.
* <b>Sickle Throw:</b> Throws one of their blades at Hornet, angling it upwards if she's in the air. Frequently used when Hornet is out of range on the platform.
**  The Sickle can be struck with the Needle to deflect it and nullify its hitbox.
**  The Sickle deals 8 damage when it comes in contact with another enemy.

Skarr Scouts deal {{Damage|1}} with all their attcks as well as on contact.

Pay attention to its animations to determine how to approach. Their swings can be easily jumped over and punished with a Needle Bounce, but getting close while the thrown attack is being charged may cause their aim to change and hit Hornet.

Skarr Scouts respawn upon re-entering the room.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Skarr Scouts have their health tripled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Skarr Scouts are primarily found in [[Hunter's March]] and the [[Far Fields]], but they also appear in the upper [[Deep Docks]] and as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|gauntlet]] in [[Halfway Home]]'s cellar.

In Hunter's March, clearing the central [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 2|gauntlet]] allows two Skarr Scouts to spawn as a random encounter on subsequent visits before [[Act 3]]. Clearing the eastern [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 3|gauntlet]] has a similar effect, spawning a Skarr Scout alongside a [[Skarrwing]] under the same conditions. In the [[Deep Docks]], Skarr Scouts near the [[Weaver Burial Spire]] start to spawn only after the [[Drifter's Cloak]] is acquired, and one in the room below appears only once [[Cling Grip]] has been acquired. In the [[Far Fields]], a room containing targets usually holds two Skarr Scouts, but one stops spawning after [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] defeats the [[Cogwork Dancers]], acquires the [[Clawline]], or visits [[Songclave]].
